svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a blank 57 wide x about 190 long (top 85, legs 38, feet 15;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: check the bend allowance on a scrap first).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fold the legs down 90 degrees, then the feet outward 90 degrees.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top 85 x 57 mm, 40 mm above the deck; front and back left open

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: so the stack's fan can draw and blow air through.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the top to the stack's mounting holes (confirm on the part).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 5.5 mm holes in each foot, 15 mm each side of the middle,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the stack sits on the top, its hydrogen inlet on the left

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: side, 5 mm above the bridge top, facing the regulator.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the stack is level; the fan face is clear of the bridge.
